name: 009_superseded_retained
description: The losing fact in a contradiction must be retained as superseded — not hard-deleted.

episodes.text:
User: I live in Mumbai.
Assistant: Great city.

User: I just relocated to Pune for a new job.
Assistant: Congratulations on the new role!

User: Pune is much quieter than Mumbai, I like it.
Assistant: A lot of engineers prefer Pune.
